engine.definition: The machine in a vehicle that produces power to move it.

battery.definition: A device that stores electrical energy and supplies power to a vehicle.

alternator.definition: A generator that supplies electrical power and charges a vehicle's battery while the engine runs.

radiator.definition: A heat exchanger that helps cool the engine by releasing heat from coolant.

lift.definition: A workshop machine that raises a vehicle so workers can reach underneath it.

grinder.definition: A power tool with a rotating abrasive disc for grinding or cutting materials.

coolant.definition: A fluid that carries heat away from an engine to help prevent overheating.

washer.definition: A small flat ring placed under a nut or bolt head to spread the load.

tune-up.definition: Maintenance and adjustments intended to improve an engine's operation.

alignment.definition: The adjustment of wheel angles so the vehicle travels as intended.

paint-job.definition: The work of painting a vehicle's exterior, or the resulting finish.

hybrid.definition: A bicycle combining features of road and mountain bikes for everyday riding.

bmx.definition: A compact, sturdy bicycle designed for motocross racing, jumps, or tricks.

wheel.definition: A circular part that turns and allows a bicycle to move.

tire.definition: The rubber covering around a bicycle wheel that grips the ground.

chain.definition: A series of metal links that transfers power from the pedals to the rear wheel.

pedal.definition: A foot-operated part that the rider pushes to move the bicycle.

frame.definition: The main supporting structure to which a bicycle's parts are attached.

rack.definition: A support attached to a bicycle for carrying luggage.

shorts.definition: Short trousers worn for cycling or other activities.

gloves.definition: Hand coverings worn for grip, comfort, or protection while cycling.

cable.definition: A flexible wire that transmits movement to brakes or gears.

brake-pad.definition: A replaceable friction pad that presses against a rim or disc to slow the wheel.

bike-lane.definition: A part of a road designated for bicycle traffic.

trail.definition: A route through a natural area used for walking or cycling.

signal.definition: To indicate an intended turn or stop to other road users.
signal.arabicTranslation: يشير إلى تغيير الاتجاه أو التوقف

stop.definition: To bring the bicycle to a standstill.

flat-tire.definition: A tire that has lost too much air to be used normally.

connector.definition: The part at the end of a charging cable that connects to a vehicle.

level-1.definition: In North American terminology, AC vehicle charging using a standard 120-volt supply.
level-1.arabicTranslation: شحن التيار المتردد من المستوى الأول

level-2.definition: In North American terminology, AC vehicle charging using a 208- or 240-volt supply.
level-2.arabicTranslation: شحن التيار المتردد من المستوى الثاني

bms.definition: A battery management system that monitors and controls a battery pack.

cell.definition: One electrochemical unit within a battery that stores and supplies electrical energy.

lighting.definition: Lights installed to illuminate the charging area.

bollard.definition: A short strong post used to protect equipment or control vehicle access.

curb.definition: The raised edge separating a roadway or parking area from a sidewalk.

bench.definition: A long seat for several people.

account.definition: A registered user's record for accessing and paying for charging services.

subscription.definition: An agreement to pay regularly for access to a charging service.

network.definition: A group of charging stations operated or connected under a shared service.

range.definition: The distance an electric vehicle can travel with its available battery charge.

voltage.definition: The electrical potential difference between two points, measured in volts.

efficiency.definition: How effectively a system uses energy, with less energy lost or wasted.

lockout.definition: A safety procedure that isolates equipment from its energy supply before work.

certification.definition: Confirmation by an authorized body that equipment meets specified requirements.
